channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Int’l visitors top 51,000 as Vietnam’s Phu Quoc draws strong Lunar New Year arrivals
item.description: More than 51,000 international visitors traveled to Vietnam’s resort island of Phu Quoc during the ongoing Lunar New Year holiday, accounting for a significant share of the nearly 170,000 arrivals recorded over a five-day period, authorities said.

item.title: Vietnam’s Ninh Binh welcomes 230,000 international visitors during Lunar New Year holiday
item.description: With its former imperial capital charm and renowned scenic landscapes, Ninh Binh Province ranked among Vietnam’s top destinations for the 2026 Lunar New Year (Tet) holiday.

item.title: Property ownership certificates for overseas Vietnamese: 'Our home is in Vietnam!'
item.description: Vietnam's 2025 Land Law opens the door for millions of overseas Vietnamese to be legally recognized as homeowners in their homeland.

item.title: Body of foreign man recovered off Vietnam’s Nha Trang beach as rough seas prompt rescues
item.description: Authorities recovered the body of a foreign man off Nha Trang beach in Khanh Hoa Province, south-central Vietnam on Friday as rough seas during the ongoing 2026 Lunar New Year holiday prompted multiple rescue operations, officials said.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City airport sets 10-year passenger record on 4th day of Tet
item.description: Tan Son Nhat International Airport in Ho Chi Minh City handled more than 170,000 passengers on Friday, the fourth day of the Lunar New Year festival, setting a record in over a decade.

item.title: 13 hospitalized after suspected poisoning from ornamental fish eggs in Vietnam
item.description: Thirteen people in Thanh Hoa Province, north-central Vietnam were hospitalized with suspected food poisoning on Thursday after eating ornamental fish eggs, believed to be from an arowana, or dragon fish, authorities said.

item.title: Vietnam’s Party chief To Lam, US President Donald Trump meet at White House to deepen two nations’ ties
item.description: General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam To Lam and U.S. President Donald Trump held talks at the White House on Friday, focusing on strengthening bilateral cooperation, including Washington’s planned removal of Vietnam from the strategic export control list, according to the Vietnamese Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

item.title: Vietnam licenses first 4 SpaceX’s Starlink gateway stations
item.description: Vietnamese authorities have granted approval for Starlink Services Vietnam Co., Ltd., the Vietnam unit of U.S.-based Space Exploration Technologies Corporation (SpaceX), to deploy its first four ground gateway stations in Vietnam, marking a key step toward rolling out Starlink satellite Internet services in the Southeast Asian country.

item.title: 6 earthquakes hit Vietnam’s Quang Ngai Province
item.description: Six earthquakes struck Mang But Commune in Quang Ngai Province, south-central Vietnam early on Saturday, including a magnitude-4.0 tremor, the Institute of Earth Sciences said.
